### Participating projects

This cluster brings together projects

- [**P02** - Grammatcal Gender in Discourse](../subprojects/P02.qmd),
- [**P03** - Mismatches in Binding and Coreference](../subprojects/P03.qmd),
- [**P05** - The Role of Self in Pronominal Reference](../subprojects/P05.qmd),
- [**P06** - The (Non-Deficiency) and (Non-)Redundancy of Clitic Pronouns](../subprojects/P06.qmd),
- [**P10** - Deficiency and Redundancy in Expressing Temporal Relations](../subprojects/P10.qmd).

### Description

The Syntax and Binding Effects cluster has concluded its work after providing a forum for collaboration on syntactic structure and binding-related phenomena. Its activities included reading groups and contributions to the Redefi Days 2025, supporting exchange across the participating subprojects and helping to consolidate shared theoretical interests.
